name: Arab USD
description: Arab USD (AUSD) is InvestArab's token with a $1 accounting value and external target. Supply is capped at 10 billion. Issuance requires deposited collateral, redeemable 1:1. The deployed collateral is a custom token named USDT, not canonical USDT; its dollar value is not independently attested. Market prices may deviate from the target.
